description: Optional fields above the Cloudflare-compatible base model. Adapters advertise both fields and semantic capabilities; field presence alone is not sufficient for lossy representations.

uploadedfilenames.description: Client filenames from actual parsed file parts, before basename/path sanitization. Decode MIME filename quoting/filename* per the adapter's documented parser; preserve path separators and nulls. Never infer from ordinary JSON fields.

uploadedfilecontents.description: One decoded textual content view per actual file part, preserving file boundaries; never concatenate parts or include ordinary form fields.

multipartpartheaders.description: One unfolded header line per actual multipart/form-data part. Preserve duplicate instances; exclude text in part contents.

multipartcharsets.description: Every parsed charset from part Content-Type and _charset_ fields, in encounter order, unquoted and trimmed. Do not discard repeated parameters or parts.

graphqlfieldnames.description: Actual field names in the selected GraphQL operation(s), including expanded fragments. Exclude aliases, comments, argument strings, and unused operations/fragments.

graphqlmaxdepth.description: Maximum selected-operation field depth after fragment expansion; root selection fields have depth 1.

graphqlaliascount.description: Maximum number of aliased field occurrences within a selected operation after fragment expansion.

graphqlbatchsize.description: Number of operation request objects in a validated HTTP GraphQL batch; a non-batched GraphQL request has size 1.

jwtalgorithm.description: Exact alg string from the decoded JOSE protected header of the authentication JWT; exact case-sensitive JSON key selection, value unchanged.

jwtkeyid.description: Exact kid string from that same decoded JOSE header, without URL decoding, path cleanup or verification-key resolution.

requestjsonpaths.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointers for every property in a fully parsed request JSON value, including intermediate objects and numeric array indices. Decode JSON escapes, then encode '~' as '~0' and '/' as '~1' in each key. Do not include values as paths.

capabilities.request_body: Complete decoded HTTP request body is available within configured truncation limits.
capabilities.response_body: Complete decoded HTTP response body is available within configured truncation limits.
capabilities.raw_request_headers: Request headers preserve duplicate field instances and original ordering.
capabilities.raw_response_headers: Response headers preserve duplicate field instances and original ordering.
capabilities.request_header_values: Request header names and values are available in a case-insensitive map.
capabilities.response_header_values: Response header names and values are available in a case-insensitive map.
capabilities.parsed_cookies: Request cookies are available as a name/value map.
capabilities.event_time: A reliable event timestamp is available.
capabilities.stateful_aggregation: The adapter and engine permit bounded keyed window state.
capabilities.cloudflare_security_actions: Cloudflare security action metadata is available.
capabilities.cloudflare_waf_scores: Cloudflare WAF attack scores are available.
capabilities.file_upload_content: Parsed multipart file contents are captured as separate bounded decoded text elements. Field values are null if any relevant part is truncated, malformed or omitted; no archive extraction is implied.
capabilities.multipart_metadata: Multipart/form-data is parsed with bounded part/header counts and documented boundary/charset handling. All part header instances and charset declarations are preserved. Incomplete or ambiguous parse results are null.
capabilities.graphql_ast: Bounded GraphQL parser resolves operationName and fragments for the executable operation(s), rejects cycles/invalid documents and accounts for aliases/depth structurally. Failed or partial metrics are null. Directives are conservatively included; no schema authorization or resolver-cost knowledge is implied.
capabilities.graphql_batch: The adapter recognizes and validates HTTP GraphQL operation request objects on a GraphQL endpoint. It counts the envelope's operations, not arbitrary JSON array elements.
capabilities.parsed_jwt: The adapter structurally parses the authentication token as compact JWS (three base64url segments), decodes the protected header as a JSON object with unique case-sensitive keys and exports its string alg/kid. No signature verification, key fetching or trust decision is implied; malformed, duplicate-key, ambiguous multi-token and encrypted JWE input yields null.
capabilities.parsed_json_body: Complete bounded JSON body parsing with duplicate object keys rejected. Paths preserve decoded key identity with RFC 6901 escaping and include intermediate object keys. Invalid, truncated or depth/node-limit-exceeding bodies yield null.
